job_title: Gauteng Dept of Health: Nursing Traineeship Programme 2027
about_role:
Location: Gauteng
Applicants are invited to apply to the Gauteng College of Nursing to study towards the Diploma in Nursing in 2027 at one of the College campuses: • Ann Latsky Campus • Chris Hani Baragwanath Campus • SG Lourens Campus • Bonalesedi Campus.
To successfully apply and be considered for the training, please take note of the following:
• You are required to register a profile on the system before you can apply.
• Must be a South African citizen, who resides in the Gauteng Province.
• You must be in possession of one of the following school leaving certificates – a Senior Certificate, a National Senior Certificate, currently in Grade 12 or National Vocational Certificate Primary Health
• Applications must be done on the GPG Professional Job Centre system before or on the 26th September;NO late applications will be accepted
• Documents will be uploaded on the system, however you will be required to take supporting documents to the selection centre should you be shortlisted.
• No hand delivered or emailed applications will be accepted, all applications must be done online.
The following subject criteria are required:
• Senior Certificate: English HG D or SG C, Biology HG D or SG C, Mathematics HG D or SG C and an M score of 17
• National Senior Certificate: English Level 4, Life Sciences Level 4, Mathematics Level 4 or Maths Literacy Level 5, and an APS of 27 or more (Life Orientation counts half the score)
• National Vocational Certificate: 50% in Fundamental Subjects (English First Additional Language, Maths/Maths Literacy, Life Orientation) and 60% in the Vocational Subjects (SA Health Care System, Public Health, The Human Body and Mind and Community Oriented Primary Care)
• Current Grade 12 learners must meet the National Senior Certificate requirements in their Grade 11 final results.
COMPETENCIES AND ATTRIBUTES:
Passion for nursing, Problem-solving ability • Patience • Ability to relate to people • Organisational ability • Leadership ability • Flexibility • Calmness during a crisis • Communication, numeracy and life skills • Computer literacy • Study skills • Honesty • Compassionate and caring.
NOTES:
All short-listed applicants will undergo a compulsory psychometric assessment. Successful applicants on psychometric assessment will be required to undergo medical surveillance, including a physical examination and verification of all documentation.
Applicants are required to scan and upload their Senior/National Senior/ National Certificate (Vocational) or statement of Grade 12 results or final Grade 11 results. Candidates can apply via the following link: https://nursingintake.gauteng.gov.za. Completion of all processes during the recruitment and selection process does not guarantee final selection on the programme.
Successful applicants will be required:
• To sign an agreement with the Gauteng Department of Health ,
• Attend lectures. Be prepared to participate in Work Integrated Learning (WIL) which includes shifts and working on public holidays, weekends and nights in Gauteng Department of Health hospitals and clinics as part of the program requirements.
PLEASE NOTE:
• Ensure that you qualify and meet the minimum requirements before you apply you do not receive feedback within 3 months after the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful.

job_title: Cummins: P1 / P2 In-Service Traineeship Programme 2026 / 2027
about_role:
Location: Johannesburg
We are seeking talented students to join our team for a 12-month P1 / P2 programme within our Service, Engineering, and Reliability functions in Johannesburg, South Africa.
The programme develops trainees from foundational learning to practical technical and operational competence in maintenance environments. It incorporates key Reliability and Industrial Engineering principles to enhance efficiency, equipment performance, and productivity, supported by structured training, assessments, and logbook completion to enable a smooth transition to value-adding work.
What the program offers:
• Exposure to both workshop and field service environments
• Gradual development from foundational learning to applied technical capability
• Integration of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering principles
• Hands-on involvement in maintenance, equipment reliability, and performance improvement
• Introduction to workflow optimisation, process efficiency, and continuous improvement
• Supported through formal training, on-the-job learning, mentorship, and structured assessments/logbooks
What you will gain from joining this program:
• Strong technical aptitude and hands-on experience in mechanical systems, tools, inspections, and diagnostic processes.
• Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills for troubleshooting and fault diagnosis.
• High level of safety awareness aligned with health, safety, and environmental standards.
• Key professional strengths including attention to detail, quality focus, teamwork, communication, and continuous learning.
• Apply theoretical knowledge in practical, real-world environments
• Demonstrate safe, compliant, and effective work practices
• Perform maintenance tasks with increasing independence and confidence
• Contribute to operational efficiency, equipment reliability, and successfully complete all assessments/logbooks
To be successful in this role you will need the following:
• Strong willingness to learn, grow, and improve continuously
• Proactive problem-solving mindset with ability to work effectively in teams and engage with technical staff
• High level of attention to detail with commitment to following procedures and maintaining quality standards
• Demonstrates accountability, discipline, reliability, and strong communication skills, including openness to feedback
Education/ Experience
• B-Tech (theory) in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering from a South African university
• Must require and be registered for P1/P2 in-service training to complete qualification
• Strong interest in mechanical systems, maintenance, and field service environments
• Basic technical understanding (advantageous) with a clear commitment to safety, quality, and continuous learning

about_role:
Role Purpose
Lead and own the overall Microsoft cloud and platform security posture across
the Client’s M365, Azure and hybrid environment. Set security standards, drive
Secure Score improvement, own Sentinel and Defender effectiveness, and act as
the senior technical authority and escalation point for platform security decisions
and complex incidents.
Key Responsibilities
• Design, implement and continuously improve security controls across M365
and Azure, including Defender suite, Sentinel, Entra ID, and Azure
governance and policy frameworks.
• Define and maintain technical security standards, baselines and patterns for
platform, cloud and M365 services aligned to CIS, NIST, ISO 27001 and
Sanlam Group standards.
• Monitor and improve Microsoft Secure Score and other posture KPIs;
conduct security assessments and gap analyses across the Microsoft estate.
• Act as L3/L4 escalation for complex or major incidents involving M365, Azure
and platform security; guide containment, forensics and recovery in
collaboration with the SOC.
• Review and approve security designs for initiatives impacting Microsoft or
cloud platforms; maintain architecture decision records and control
rationale.
• Govern PKI, Azure Key Vault, DevSecOps controls, GitHub Advanced Security
and AI/Copilot security guardrails in collaboration with the
Platform/DevSecOps engineer.
• Provide escalation support and technical mentorship to all security
engineers; uplift team capability across Microsoft security technologies.
• Represent platform security in architecture, project and Group forums;
ensure local controls align to Sanlam Group cyber standards and audit
expectations.
• Coordinate with infrastructure, EUC, cloud platform, risk, audit and project
delivery stakeholders to ensure security is embedded across delivery
initiatives.
Scope Boundaries
• Does not own day-to-day EUC/endpoint operations (Intune/MECM) or IAM
lifecycle administration; provides technical standards, challenge authority
and escalation support to those roles.
• Infrastructure, cloud and application teams retain operational ownership of
their platforms; this role provides security leadership, guidance and
escalation.
• Policy approval, budget authority and formal risk acceptance remain with
cyber leadership and governance forums.
Decision Rights
• Approve or recommend Microsoft and platform security design patterns,
baseline controls and technical control configurations within delegated
authority.
• Direct emergency containment measures for critical platform security
threats in line with incident procedures and delegated emergency response
authority.
• Escalate material control gaps, remediation delays, unsupported platforms
or elevated residual risks to cyber leadership and relevant accountability
owners.
• Recommend security tooling, architecture enhancements and operating
model changes to improve resilience, compliance and efficiency.

• Reverse Engineering: Skilled in the "breakdown" of multi-component chemical mixtures to identify impurities or formulation shifts.

The Senior Cloud Engineer – Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing scalable, secure, and high-performing cloud infrastructure solutions within Google Cloud environments. • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, or similar languages.
• Experience implementing and supporting CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills within cross-functional teams.

Desirable Skills & Experience

• Experience tuning and optimising cloud platform performance.
• Exposure to Kubernetes administration and container orchestration best practices.
• Experience supporting enterprise-scale cloud environments.
Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

Behavioural Competencies

• Excellent collaboration and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
• High attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.
• Proactive and continuous improvement mindset.
What We Offer

• Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale cloud transformation initiatives.
• Exposure to modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices.
• Collaborative and innovative engineering environment.
• Professional growth and certification opportunities.
• Opportunity to contribute to impactful cloud and technology solutions.

With more than 34400 students, and approximately 1700 members of staff, the Durban University of Technology (DUT) is a leading university of technology proudly located in the beautiful cities of Durban and Pietermaritzburg, along the warm east coast of South Africa. MAIN PURPOSE OF POSITION:
Manage the allocated debtors’ book by collecting payments on or before they are due and minimizing bad debts by following internal policies and procedures. Establish and maintain excellent relationships with all internal and external parties through constant communication. Work in line with credit legislation. Resolving account-related queries with a matter of urgency and maintaining an elevated level of customer service on all matters related to Accounts Receivable.
Credit Controller Duties and Responsibilities
Banking and Payment Allocations:
• Checking the various bank statements daily to identify payments made for the debtors assigned to the credit controller.
• Capturing the payment receipt on the ERP system.
• Allocating the payment according to the official remittance from the partner or an email from the partner advising which invoices to clear with the specific payment. Payments may NEVER be allocated from the oldest invoices forward UNLESS the credit controller has written confirmation from the Finance manager at the partner’s company.
• Save the payment batch in the specified folder for auditing purposes in line with the payment allocation process.
• If the credit controller has no remittance or instruction email on how to allocate the payment at the time the payment shows on the bank statement, the credit controller must phone and email the partner for the remittance or payment instructions. The credit controller will follow up on the remittance or payment instruction email daily for 2 days, and then the AR Supervisor must request the remittance or payment instruction email from the partner.
• If a remittance or payment instruction email is still not received on day 3 after the payment was received on the account, the credit controller will send a debtor’s aging ledger to the partner, marking which invoices will be cleared with the specific payment, and will then email it to the partner advising that allocation will take place accordingly. Payments allocated in this manner will not be reversed later when a remittance or payment instruction is received.Customer Statements:
• As soon as the Group Credit & AR Manager confirms all statements have been sent after month-end closure, the Credit controller will check System1A daily to ensure that the partners have viewed their statements.
• If the partner has not viewed their statement after the 3rd day, the credit controller will phone and email the partner to confirm the statement link was received and check if it was sent to junk mail or blocked.
• If the partner confirms that the statement has still not been received, the credit controller will resend a statement and ask the partner to confirm receiptInvoices, PODs, Credit notes, and Other Supporting Documents:
• The credit controller must send out Invoices, PODs, Credit notes, and all other supporting documents as and when required by the partner.
• The credit controller must then also educate the partner to use System1A so that they may access any required documents from that system in the future.
Recons:
• The credit controller must have an updated recons with full reasons for non-payment on EVERY account that has queries. This bank reconciliation must be ready and available to be sent to sales, the AR Supervisor, and or the Group Credit and AR Manager as needed.
• Collection process:
• The credit controller must phone each account on their assigned debtors book a minimum of 3 times:
• After the month-end statements are sent to ensure the statement was received and viewed.
• In the middle of the month to ask if there are any queries or issues to address before the month-end payment is due.
• The last week of the month to confirm the amount and date of payment for the payment that is due at the month's end, and to ensure that the payment is made so that it is in our bank on or before the last day of the month.
• It must be made clear to partners that we cannot allow late payments after payments are made.
• The credit controller must pull their age every Monday and work on it for the week by prioritizing the highest and oldest overdue accounts.
• These partners must be contacted once a week until their account is paid for in full
• The credit controller must also contact partners that have unapplied payments (and again remind the partner that this can be viewed on System1A) and or credit notes on their account, and ask the partner to either take back the payment or credits with their next payment or to advise the credit controller how to allocate
• Any unallocated cash (older than 6 months) and unallocated credits (older than 3 months) will be moved off the account.
• The credit controller must ask for the assistance of the sales team when collection efforts have been unsuccessful and ask them to arrange meetings with the partners to discuss the overdue payments, but the credit controller may never expect the salesperson to collect outstanding payments on their behalf.Monthly SPLA Order Process
• After the 8th working day of the new month, a report will be sent to the credit controller (Applicable to credit controllers dealing with Cloud partners) by the Cloud Partner Support team. The Credit controller then must urgently ensure that the following is done before the 15th working day of the new month for the business to release the partner’s SPLA orders:
• Overdue accounts – phone the partner and ask for immediate payment, advising we won’t be able to release their SPLA orders if their account is not paid up to date.
• The credit controller must also remind the partner of the 8% late reporting penalty from Microsoft or possible termination if we cannot release SPLA orders.
• Over-trading accounts - phone the partner and ask for immediate payment to bring their account into credit again, advising we won’t be able to release their SPLA orders if their account does not have sufficient credit limit.
• The credit controller must also remind the partner of the 8% late reporting penalty from Microsoft or possible termination if we cannot release SPLA orders.

Purpose of the Role:
The FAIS Supervisor plays a key role in supporting the Key Individual (“KI”) by ensuring that all
external agents, quality assurance agents or call centre agents adhere to the requirements as
provided for in the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act (“FAIS”). The role reports
directly to the Head of Legal and Compliance, though the FAIS Supervisor will be trained and
managed by the KI, gaining valuable experience and mentorship with a view to ultimately
transition into a future KI role. The Supervisor will act as the primary line of defense in
conjunction with the Quality Assurance Team in identifying and addressing any compliance
issues within sales practices, reviewing the effectiveness of the Quality Assurance processes,
ensuring that the KI's strategic oversight is well-supported with accurate and consistent
monitoring.
This role ensures that sales practices across all distribution channels meet legal standards,
thereby protecting the company from legal risks and ensuring that all agents operate ethically
and within regulatory boundaries.
The FAIS Supervisor is essential in maintaining the integrity of the supervisory process and
ensuring that all agents meet the required competencies to be fully independent.
Role Summary:
As the FAIS Supervisor, you will take on the direct supervision of agents, regularly evaluating
their sales activities to ensure they meet the FAIS requirements and other regulatory
standards.
Your primary focus will be to ensure that agents comply with legal requirements, avoid
misrepresentation, and protect customers from mis-selling. You will conduct monthly
competency assessments, review sales practices, and ensure ongoing compliance, providing
the KI with detailed reports and feedback on agent performance. This data will be crucial for
the KI to assess agent competency, identify training needs, and make informed decision.
You will play a key role in maintaining the integrity of the compliance process, ensuring clear
communication with both agents and the KI about performance and compliance issues. By
thoroughly assessing sales processes, offering coaching, and identifying areas for
improvement, you will help the KI mitigate regulatory risks and create an environment where
agents can succeed, achieve their goals, and positively impact the lives of our customers.
Benefits:
• The right candidate will have a clear path for growth into a KI role, with the opportunity to
work closely alongside the KI and Head of Legal and Compliance. This collaboration will
provide valuable hands-on experience in compliance leadership and regulatory oversight.
• Ongoing mentorship and training in regulatory compliance, enhancing skills for future
leadership roles.Key Responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance Oversight:
• Ensure that all call centre agents adhere to the requirements in FAIS and other regulatory
requirements by monitoring their daily activities, reviewing sales interactions, and
confirming that legal standards are met.Competency Assessments:
• Development of Supervision Plans for each agent requiring supervision.
• Conduct monthly competency evaluations of agents, assessing their ability to comply with
FAIS requirements, demonstrating ethical sales practices, and identifying areas for
improvement.Sales Activity Monitoring:
• Review and evaluate a sample of sales calls and transactions, ensuring compliance with
FAIS and preventing misrepresentation or mis-selling. Ensure that agents meet all legal
and ethical sales requirements.Reporting and Feedback:
• Prepare detailed compliance reports for the KI, summarizing the results of your
assessments and feedback on agent performance. Provide actionable recommendations
for ongoing training and improvements.Communication with Agents:
• Deliver clear and constructive feedback to agents, outlining areas for improvement and
reinforcing compliance standards. Set specific expectations for performance, ensuring
alignment with regulatory requirements.Agent Development and Training:
• Work closely with agents to identify competency gaps and provide coaching to improve
performance. Assist in the development of agents so they can eventually transition from
supervision to independent operation.Documentation and Record Keeping:
• Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all assessments, evaluations, and feedback
sessions, ensuring proper documentation for compliance reviews and audits with
company compliance strategies and address any compliance concerns or issues.
Risk Mitigation:
• Identify potential compliance risks and proactively recommend corrective actions to
minimise legal exposure. Support the KI in addressing compliance issues and maintaining
the company’s reputation for legal and ethical conduct.Technical Skills:
• Strong understanding of FAIS, compliance requirements, and other applicable financial
services regulations.
• High level of proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and Word, to analyse data,
generate reports, and document compliance activities.
• Skilled in reviewing sales processes to spot any compliance issues and suggest practical
improvements.
Soft Skills:
• Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively provide feedback to Agents,
Team Leaders, Supervisors, and preparation of detailed compliance reports for the KI.
• A meticulous approach to reviewing sales activities, identifying compliance risks, and
ensuring accuracy in reporting.
• Commitment to upholding high standards of integrity and ethical conduct, especially
when dealing with sensitive compliance matters.
• Demonstrated capacity for leading, mentoring, and coaching agents while ensuring
compliance with regulatory standards.
• Ability to quickly adapt to evolving regulations, processes, and company requirements.Experience:
• 3+ years of experience in the long-term insurance industry, with a focus on compliance,
supervision, or regulatory oversight.
• Call centre experience preferred but not required.
• Proven track record in assessing and monitoring sales performance, especially in relation
to compliance standards and regulatory requirements.
• Experience providing coaching, feedback and performance improvement plans to help
agents align with compliance standards.
• Ability to speak and understand multiple languages
Qualifications:
• Minimum NQF Level 5 Qualification (FSCA recognised)
• RE 1 / RE 5: Regulatory exams (Beneficial)
• FAIS-Specific Training, Additional FAIS or compliance certifications are highly
advantageous to demonstrate a strong grasp of relevant financial regulations.

job_title: Full-Time Remote Video Editor — AI Video Ads (Kling + AI Tools) for a US Ecommerce Brand
about_role:
FULL-TIME REMOTE VIDEO EDITOR — AI VIDEO ADS FOR A US ECOMMERCE BRAND
We are a US-based ecommerce company hiring full-time remote video editors to produce short video ads (30–60 seconds) for Facebook and Instagram. This is a long-term, permanent full-time position — we are looking for people who want stable work with one company, not a short project. We are hiring MORE THAN ONE editor for this role. Work is fully remote.
THE ROLE
You will receive a complete package for every ad: a finished script, a creative brief, and example videos showing the style to match. Your job is to turn that package into a finished video ad:
- Generate AI video clips using image-to-video tools (we use Kling via Higgsfield — we provide all accounts and all tools, you pay for nothing)
- Generate the starting images for those clips with AI image tools, using prompts you develop with our AI assistant
- Source real B-roll clips from TikTok, YouTube, and similar platforms where the shot calls for it
- Generate the voiceover with AI (ElevenLabs) from the provided script
- Assemble everything in the editing software you are most comfortable with (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, etc.): edit to the voiceover, add captions, add music, export
- Each ad is delivered as three versions with different openings (we will train you on our exact method — it is fast once learned)
You do not write scripts and you do not need marketing knowledge. We provide the script, the brief, and the reference videos. You provide clean, fast, good-looking execution. Work is assigned and tracked through a simple board — you always know exactly what to work on next.
SCHEDULE AND PAY
Full-time, 8 hours per day, Monday to Saturday. USD $600–$1,200 per month depending on experience, fixed, paid reliably every month. Real opportunity for pay growth as your output proves itself — we are building a long-term creative team and this role grows with the company.
HOW TO APPLY
Follow these instructions exactly. Applications that skip any step will not be read.
1. Start your application message with the word KINGFISHER on the first line.
2. Include a link to your portfolio or showreel.
3. List the AI video/image tools you have personally used and one sentence on what you made with each. If you have used Claude or another AI assistant, say so and tell us what for.
4. Confirm you are available full-time, Monday to Saturday, and are applying as an individual.
5. Answer this short exercise. Imagine you are producing a video ad from a script we gave you. Four situations come up. For each one, tell us which ONE action you would take and give one sentence explaining why.
a) One line of the script feels awkward to you and you think you could word it better. Do you: REWRITE IT / FLAG IT AND BUILD IT AS WRITTEN / SKIP THAT LINE?
b) The example video we gave you for style reference features a well-known influencer talking to camera. Do you: CLIP HER FOOTAGE INTO OUR AD / RECREATE THE SAME STYLE OF SHOT WITH AN AI-GENERATED PERSON / ASK US TO LICENSE HER FOOTAGE?
c) An AI-generated clip looks great except the person's hands are warped. Do you: SHIP IT, VIEWERS WON'T NOTICE / REGENERATE THE CLIP WITH A FIXED PROMPT / CROP THE HANDS OUT IF POSSIBLE, OTHERWISE REGENERATE?
d) You need a generic clip of a dog running in a park and can't find good free footage. Do you: LEAVE THAT SHOT OUT / GENERATE IT WITH AI / USE A CLIP THAT ALMOST FITS?
Shortlisted candidates will have a short video interview, and final candidates will complete a SHORT PAID test project (we pay you for it). We read every application that follows the instructions.

job_title: Wine Sales Specialist Consultant | Meridian Wine Merchants | Gauteng
about_role:
Meridian Wine Merchants is currently seeking a passionate and results-driven individual to join our team as a Wine Sales Specialist Consultant. At Meridian Wine Merchants, we expertly combine tradition and innovation to provide outstanding products tailored to our diverse clients. This position is based in Gauteng.
Duties and Responsibilities
• Identify, develop and convert new premium business opportunities while growing premium wine sales, profitability and portfolio performance across allocated territories.
• Develop annual customer growth plans, identify new premium opportunities, and implement initiatives that expand premium category sales.
• Execute wine list recommendations, premium portfolio placements, and listing opportunities within targeted customer segments and outlets.
• Proactively identify, prospect and convert new premium restaurants, hotels, hospitality groups and specialist wine customers within the allocated territory.
• Develop trusted long-term client relationships that position Meridian as the preferred premium wine partner while expanding customer value.
• Conduct customer-led trade visits to identify execution opportunities, customer requirements, visibility gaps, and portfolio growth opportunities.
• Lead premium tastings, winemaker dinners, customer events and educational experiences that generate new business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships.
• Develop customer-specific growth plans by identifying premium category opportunities, menu opportunities, new listings and premium portfolio expansion opportunities.
• Review customer wine offerings, identify gaps and growth opportunities, recommend commercially successful wine selections, and establish premium category standards.
• Gather and communicate customer insights, competitor activity, wine list trends, and regional market intelligence to support strategic commercial decisions.
• Identify new premium trading areas, emerging customer segments and untapped market opportunities for future business growth.
• Execute customer and portfolio segmentation strategies to ensure the right portfolio mix within the right customer environments.
• Execute cycle briefs, premium trade initiatives, promotional campaigns, and activation plans in conjunction with Trade Marketing and the Wine Specialist Manager.
• Work closely with Distribution, Trade Marketing, Key Accounts, Sales Reps, Finance, and internal support teams to ensure product availability and operational execution.
• Coach Sales Representatives on premium portfolio positioning, customer opportunities and premium selling techniques.
• Deliver premium wine education, food pairing guidance and category development sessions that strengthen customer capability and drive premium wine sales.
• Ensure disciplined usage and maintenance of Repforce, Truedata, reporting tools, and customer databases.
• Continuously maintain and improve wine, competitor, portfolio, commercial and premium category knowledge.
Requirements
• Grade 12 (Matric) plus Cape Wine Academy Wine Certificate
• Minimum 4+ years’ experience in FMCG liquor sales and merchandising across premium customer environments
• Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, CG Cloud) advantageous
• Valid driver’s licence, own reliable vehicle, and right to work in South Africa
Why Join Meridian?
Meridian Wine Merchants connects some of South Africa's most exciting premium wine brands with the country's leading restaurants, retailers, hotels and wine professionals. Every day is an opportunity to learn, grow and make an impact in an industry we're passionate about.
We're a team that works hard, celebrates success and is always looking for better ways to do things. We value people who bring energy, curiosity, integrity and a genuine love for wine. Here, your ideas matter, your contribution is recognised, and your growth is part of our success.
If you're passionate about premium wine, thrive in a fast-moving environment and want to build a career where you'll be challenged, supported and inspired every day, come and grow with us.

African Parks is a non-profit conservation organization that takes on the complete responsibility for the rehabilitation and long-term management of national parks in partnership with governments and local communities. We currently manage 23 national parks and protected areas in 13 countries covering over 20 million hectares in: Angola, Benin, Central African Republic, Chad, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Malawi, Mozambique, Republic of Congo, Rwanda, Zambia, Zimbabwe, South Sudan and Ethiopia.
The Great Nile Migration Landscape (GNML) in South Sudan spans over 120,000 km² across Badingilo and Boma National Parks, Jonglei State, and adjoining community lands. It forms one of Africa’s most important ecological systems, connecting the Sudd wetlands in the west to the Boma highlands in the east. The landscape supports extraordinary biodiversity, including the largest land mammal migration on earth comprising around 6 million animals.

Job Overview:
Are you energetic, ambitious, and looking to develop your career? Our Study Abroad department is looking to add a Debtors Clerk to their team. We offer a dynamic and challenging environment where we achieve our business objectives and have fun doing it.
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Debtors Clerk to manage client debtor accounts and support the accurate and timely collection of outstanding amounts. The role will be responsible for invoicing, allocating receipts, reconciling accounts, following up on overdue balances, resolving debtor queries, and maintaining complete financial records. The successful candidate will work closely with the finance, advisory and operations teams to ensure that debtor information is accurate, payments are collected within agreed terms, and financial processes support a positive client experience.
You're perfect for this position if you:
• Have previous experience in a debtors, credit control, accounts receivable, bookkeeping or finance administration role.
• Understand debtor account reconciliations, payment allocations, invoicing and collection processes.
• Are confident working with Microsoft Excel, accounting systems and CRM platforms; experience with Xero is advantageous.
• Have excellent attention to detail and can maintain accurate, complete and confidential financial records.
• Communicate professionally and confidently with clients, colleagues and external partners.
• Are organised, reliable and able to manage competing deadlines independently.
• Are proactive, solutions-oriented and comfortable following up on outstanding payments.
• Can investigate discrepancies and resolve account queries efficiently.
• Maintain a high level of discretion, integrity and confidentiality. Your role and responsibilities:
Among other tasks, your main responsibilities will include:
Debtors administration and invoicing
• Managing and maintaining accurate debtor accounts for clients and other relevant payers.
• Preparing, checking and issuing invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation accurately and on time.
• Ensuring invoices reflect approved fees, payment terms and relevant contractual arrangements.
• Sending account statements and payment reminders in accordance with agreed collection procedures.
• Maintaining complete records of invoices, receipts, adjustments, correspondence and payment arrangements. Collections and account follow-up
• Monitoring outstanding balances and proactively following up on overdue accounts by email and telephone.
• Engaging professionally with clients to secure payment and agree appropriate payment arrangements where authorised.
• Escalating long-outstanding, disputed or high-risk accounts to management in line with internal procedures.
• Monitoring adherence to payment plans and following up immediately when agreed payments are missed.
• Providing clear updates to internal stakeholders on overdue accounts and collection activity. Receipting, allocation and reconciliations
• Verifying payments received and allocating receipts accurately to the correct debtor accounts and invoices.
• Reconciling debtor ledgers, bank receipts, CRM records and accounting system balances.
• Investigating and resolving unallocated receipts, short payments, overpayments and other account discrepancies.
• Assisting with month-end debtor reconciliations and ensuring outstanding items are supported and followed up.
• Maintaining accurate and complete audit trails for all debtor transactions and adjustments. Queries and reporting
• Acting as a key point of contact for debtor and invoice-related queries from clients, advisors and internal teams.
• Resolving billing and payment queries promptly, professionally and with appropriate supporting documentation.
• Preparing debtor ageing reports, collection updates and other reports on outstanding balances and payment trends.
• Working closely with finance and operational teams to improve debtor processes, reporting and controls. Administrative support
• Managing a shared inbox and reassigning emails to the correct staff member.
• Converting relevant university marketing emails into notices so that important information can be shared with staff members.
• Maintaining data and contacts on the CRM by gathering the correct email addresses from university representatives. Additional finance support
• Monitoring commission payments due from partner universities and following up on outstanding amounts.
• Reconciling commission receipts against sales records, enrolment information and agreements.
• Assisting with client and staff commission administration where required.
• Capturing relevant income information and payment updates accurately in CRM and accounting systems.
• Supporting system and process improvements, including CRM and Xero integration or automation initiatives. About Sable International
Sable International offers innovative professional services to international citizens. We create tailor-made solutions to meet the accounting, wealth, financial, currency, and nationality needs of our clients. We pride ourselves on providing solutions that suit our client’s unique individual circumstances; our employees are key in achieving this goal.
The staff in our Abuja, Cape Town, Durban, Harare, Johannesburg, Kampala, London, Lagos, Lusaka, Melbourne, and Monte Estoril offices are passionate about their areas of expertise and take pride in helping our clients achieve their goals. As a result, we have an energised and fun company culture, something that sets us apart from other professional services firms.

job_title: Performance Marketing Lead — Meta / Facebook Ads
about_role:
We're looking for an exceptional Meta media buyer who operates the way the best marketers will operate in 2026: with AI in the loop at every step. You'll own high-volume Facebook and Instagram campaigns end to end — strategy, creative production, launch, and optimisation — with aggressive CPA targets and real budget authority.
This is not a role for someone who dabbles with ChatGPT for ad copy. We want someone who has rebuilt their entire workflow around AI: driving campaign optimisation programmatically through the Meta Ads API and MCP-connected agents, generating and iterating video creative with AI tools in hours rather than weeks, and letting data — not habit — decide what runs.
What You'll Do
• Own high-volume campaigns — plan, launch, and scale Meta campaigns across multiple ad accounts, owning performance against tight CPA and ROAS targets.
• Optimise with AI in the loop — build and run agentic workflows (MCP servers, Meta Ads API, custom scripts, or tools like Claude) that monitor spend, surface anomalies, rotate creative, and execute budget and bid changes at a pace no manual buyer can match.
• Create video at speed — produce ad videos on the fly using AI video generation and editing tools (e.g. Runway, Veo, Sora, Kling, HeyGen, CapCut and similar), turning a creative brief into live test variants same-day.
• Handle editing and banner design — cut, caption, resize, and version video for placements; design static banners and image ads to a standard good enough to ship without a designer in the loop.
• Run a rigorous testing programme — structure high-tempo creative testing — hooks, formats, angles, audiences — and feed the results back into both the creative pipeline and the account structure.
• Stay on top of the data — own tracking, attribution (Pixel, CAPI, post-back), reporting, and the numbers behind every decision. You should be able to explain any account's performance from memory.
• Build the playbook — document what works, systematise it, and raise the bar for how the whole company buys media

job_title: Sales Administrator & Client Liaison Coordinator (Outdoor Advertising & Media)
about_role:
Sales Administrator & Client Liaison Coordinator (Outdoor Advertising & Media)
Location: Cape Town (Remote/Home-Based)
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-Time
Salary: R20,000 – R30,000 CTC per month (depending on experience)
Additional Benefits: Company laptop provided, home office allowance, opportunities for career growth.
About the Company
Our client is a well-established South African Out-of-Home (OOH) media company that owns and manages premium outdoor advertising assets across the country. Their portfolio includes traditional billboards, digital LED screens, wallscapes, and other high-impact advertising solutions positioned in strategic, high-traffic locations.
Working with leading advertising agencies, media buyers, and direct corporate clients, the business helps brands increase visibility through targeted outdoor advertising campaigns supported by market data and audience insights.
Following an exciting period of business restructuring and investment in new technology, including the implementation of Salesforce CRM, the company is entering its next phase of growth. They are now looking to appoint a highly organised, commercially minded individual who will become an integral part of their Cape Town operation.
About the Opportunity
This is a unique hybrid role combining Sales Administration, Client Service, Account Coordination, and Business Development.
The successful candidate will become the Cape Town representative and trusted support to the Sales Director, taking ownership of administrative functions while gradually developing and managing client relationships.
Initially, the role will focus heavily on administration and client coordination. As confidence and experience grow, the successful candidate will be given responsibility for managing smaller agency accounts, developing new business opportunities, and representing the business at client meetings.
This position is ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships, is commercially curious, takes initiative, and wants to grow into an Account Manager or Business Development role within the media and advertising industry.
Key Responsibilities
Sales Administration
• Provide day-to-day administrative support to the sales function.
• Assist with preparing and processing client briefs.
• Coordinate advertising campaign requirements with internal teams.
• Follow up on Proof of Flight (POF) documentation and campaign verification.
• Liaise with internal operations to obtain campaign photographs and supporting documentation.
• Monitor campaign progress and ensure deadlines are met.
• Follow up on client instructions and confirmations.
• Coordinate documentation required for campaign implementation.
• Assist with CRM management and maintaining accurate client records.
• Support both the Johannesburg and Cape Town sales teams with administrative requirements.
Client Service & Account Coordination
Build strong relationships with advertising agencies and direct clients.
• Respond professionally to client enquiries.
• Provide exceptional service throughout campaign delivery.
• Maintain regular communication with assigned clients.
• Visit clients when required on behalf of the Sales Director.
• Deliver promotional items and maintain regular client engagement.
• Represent the business professionally during client interactions.
• Assist with campaign reporting and post-campaign follow-up.  Business Development
As experience grows, responsibilities will expand to include:
• Managing smaller advertising agencies.
• Developing dormant client relationships.
• Identifying new business opportunities.
• Prospecting direct clients for Digital Out-of-Home advertising.
• Building long-term relationships with advertisers.
• Identifying opportunities to increase advertising spend.
• Assisting with sales presentations and proposals.
• Supporting revenue growth across the Cape Town region.
General Administration
Maintain accurate documentation.
• Process sales-related paperwork.
• Coordinate internal communication between departments.
• Assist with reporting requirements.
• Ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time.
• Support continuous improvement of administrative processes through Salesforce CRM.

- Salary: R60,000.00 Gross PM + Commission (10% of total dealership net profit)
- Status: Full-Time, Permanent following a successful 3-month probation period

- People Management: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of departmental managers and workshop staff while driving a high-performing culture.
- OEM & Stakeholder Relations: Maintain robust relationships with represented Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and ensure 100% compliance with franchise standards.
- Customer Excellence: Cultivate a customer-centric environment to maximize client retention and maximize CSI (Customer Satisfaction Index) scores.

About the Role
We are seeking an energetic, target-driven, and highly articulate B2B Telesales Executive to drive lead generation across two distinct business sectors: (skills development and corporate training) and an established Consulting Firm (financial and accounting services).
In this dual-focused role, you will be responsible for cold outreach, market research, and opening doors with key decision-makers in both large corporate environments and SMEs. You will qualify prospects and seamlessly hand over viable opportunities to the respective CEOs, who will drive discovery and close the deals.
Key Responsibilities
1.(Skills Development & Corporate Training)
• Conduct market research to identify key decision-makers at large corporates and listed entities.
• Target leadership within HR, Procurement, Business Development, and BEE Specialists.
• Generate qualified leads for skills development, staff training, and learnership programs.
• Capitalize on market seasonality tied to skills levies and BEE scorecard cycles.
• Establish prospect interest and hand qualified opportunities over to the CEO for deal closure.
2. Accounting Firm (Financial & Accounting Services)
• Conduct market research targeting Small to Medium Enterprises (SMEs) across a broad range of revenue sizes.
• Identify opportunities for accounting, bookkeeping, and financial management services.
• Establish prospect interest and hand off confirmed opportunities to the CEO for discovery and closure.
3. General & Operational Responsibilities
• Build, maintain, and manage an independent prospect database across both target markets.
• Execute high-volume outbound telesales calls to meet and exceed weekly KPIs.
• Maintain meticulous records of outreach, interactions, and follow-ups using agreed-upon lead generation templates.
• Provide regular feedback on market opportunities, trends, and prospect objections.
• Work collaboratively with management teams from both businesses.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• Volume: Minimum of 5 qualified leads submitted per week.
• Lead Quality: High lead confirmation rate (percentage of leads confirmed as genuine opportunities upon CEO review).
• Targeting: High decision-maker fit rate (verified contact with HR, Procurement, or Business Development leads).
• Activity: Seasonally-adjusted call and dial activity aligned with corporate levy/BEE cycles.
Accounting Firm
• Volume: Minimum of 5 qualified leads submitted per week.
• Lead Quality: High lead confirmation rate following review.
• Efficiency: Fast time-to-handoff (routing leads for review within agreed turnaround times after first contact).
• Activity: Meeting weekly call and dial volume targets.
Overall Metrics
• Consistent weekly call volume and contact attempts.
• Strong alignment with prospect fit and lead quality standards.
• Active participation in weekly check-ins with both management teams.
Candidate Profile & Requirements
Essential Requirements
• Experience: Proven background in B2B telesales, outbound lead generation, or business development.
• Market Exposure: Demonstrated experience selling into large corporates, listed entities, and/or SMEs.
• Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills; professional, articulate, and persuasive on the phone.
• Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software/lead tracking tools.
Personal Attributes
• Resilient & Persistent: Comfortable handling rejection and tenacious with follow-ups.
• Self-Motivated: Able to work independently, manage time effectively, and handle dual business priorities.
• Detail-Oriented: Disciplined with record-keeping and data entry.
• Target-Driven: Competitive mindset with a strong desire to meet performance-based incentives.
• Domain Interest: Quick learner with a keen interest in skills development, BEE scorecards, and financial services.

about_role:

The Senior Systems Analyst – Point of Sale & Omnichannel is responsible for analysing, designing, documenting, supporting, and continuously improving Cape Union Mart’s Point of Sale platforms, omnichannel sales journeys, store transaction processes, and related retail systems.
The role provides senior systems analysis capability across business-critical retail systems supporting in-store sales, online-to-store journeys, click-and-collect, pick-from-store, returns and exchanges across channels, tendering, promotions, customer lookup, loyalty, gift cards, end-of-day processing, store trading operations, and transaction integrity.

• Analyse requirements, processes, system behaviours, and integration impacts across POS, eCommerce, OMS, fulfilment, and omnichannel sales.

• Participate in Agile delivery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and governance forums.
• Collaborate with business, IT, and vendor teams to support seamless customer and operational experiences across channels.

Experience:

• 2+ years’ experience working with complex business-critical systems in a senior analyst or specialist capacity.

• Experience with Point of Sale, store trading, retail operations, payments, promotions, customer, loyalty, or transactional retail systems.

• Experience working across POS, eCommerce, OMS, payments, loyalty, promotions, inventory, and finance reconciliation systems would be beneficial.
• Experience supporting business-critical production systems, including incidents, releases, change management, and operational support processes.
• Experience analysing APIs, middleware, databases, integrations, batch processes, and cloud-based platforms.
• Retail store operations, Point of Sale, payments, loyalty, promotions, or finance reconciliation experience would be advantageous.
Technical Skills:

• Ability to write functional specifications, technical specifications, interface requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
• Understanding of omnichannel retail architecture, including POS, eCommerce, order management, inventory availability, fulfilment, payment, loyalty, and customer platforms.
• Ability to analyse cross-channel transaction flows, order lifecycle events, integration messages, reconciliation points, and operational exceptions.
• Understanding of API integrations and REST/SOAP web services.
• Strong SQL skills for data analysis, investigation, reconciliation, and issue diagnosis.
• Experience working with JSON, XML, SQL databases, POS transactions, logs, monitoring tools, and integration traces.

job_title: Key Account Manager / Field Sales Engineer
about_role:
Job Purpose
The Key Account Manager / Field Sales Engineer (KAM) is responsible for managing, retaining and growing a portfolio of key accounts by increasing sales and expanding product penetration across the customer base.
The KAM keeps customers informed of new technologies within company's (AA) line card, visits customers on a regular and planned basis, and prepares accurate, timely quotations in response to each customer request.
Success in this role depends on close collaboration across AA's internal functions.
The KAM is expected to draw on AA's engineering resources to promote new products, support design-in activity, and secure sustainable, long-term sales growth.
Key Responsibilities:
Account & Relationship Management
Establish, maintain and manage all aspects of the customer relationship, including technical support, marketing engagement and internal sales support.
Identify short-term and long-term customer needs to determine total available business potential within each account.
Develop, review and maintain account objectives and strategies, addressing customer needs and business objectives.
Strategic Account Planning & Business Development
Develop, review and update account objectives and strategies that align with both customer needs and AA's business objectives.
Proactively promote and sell AA's full product portfolio in line with marketing strategy, extending reach to all potential customers.
Proactively identify and pursue ‘design-in’ opportunities, engaging technical and engineering support as required.
Research and investigate new business opportunities, market trends and competitor activity.
Partner with AA's suppliers to initiate and drive joint customer visits to major accounts.
Sales Planning, Forecasting & Reporting
Prepare accurate sales forecasts and budgets for the assigned account portfolio.
Monthly sales reporting on call plans and MML report.
Ensure all customer negotiations are conducted within defined costing and financial parameters.
Internal Collaboration & Team Coordination
Liaise and collaborate with internal departments, effectively coordinating resources in support of account objectives.
Manage the activities of the sales administrator(s) reporting into this role to ensure effective conversion of orders into confirmed sales.
Attend and actively participate in sales and product training sessions and meetings.
Presentations & Stakeholder Engagement
Prepare and deliver presentations to existing and prospective major customers, including at senior management and director level.
Prepare and deliver presentations at internal sales meetings, reporting on progress with new and existing major accounts.
General
Undertake additional responsibilities as reasonably requested by customers or assigned by management.
Core Responsibilities:
Governance and Risk Management
Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable governance frameworks, including POPIA and ISO requirements, together with related AA policies, procedures and reporting structures.
Identify, escalate and help mitigate commercial, contractual and reputational risks arising within the account portfolio.
Maintain accurate, up-to-date and confidential customer records in line with data protection and information security requirements.
External Parties and Relationship Management
Build and sustain trusted, professional relationships with customers and suppliers that support AA's reputation as a best-in-class partner.
Represent AA professionally and consistently in all external engagements, ensuring alignment with company values and brand standards.
Communications & Working Relationships:
Purpose of Integration:
Account strategy alignment, forecasting, pipeline review and escalation of customer requirements.
Alignment on asset-related requirements and equipment supporting customer engagements.
Coordination of stock availability, delivery scheduling and order fulfilment for key accounts.
Order processing, credit terms, invoicing accuracy and resolution of account queries.
Deliver a best-in-class standard of service excellence, technical support and account management.
Joint account planning, technical collaboration and coordinated customer engagement

• Extensive experience within Excel is required.

1. Account Maintenance & Credit Management
• Distribute credit applications to new customers and manage credit limit increases/decreases.
• Review all credit applications for completeness and accuracy upon receipt.
• Submit CGIC approval requests via the Cregalink application and forward to the AR Manager for approval.
• Create new customers on the ERP system and upload approved/declined credit applications to the Company Shared Drive (Google Drive).
• Maintain accurate customer master data including CGIC status, email addresses, delivery addresses, contact details, and sales representative allocations.
• Ensure all customer-related portals are understood and compliance requirements are adhered to.

• Release orders carefully and efficiently within two hours of receipt from Order Management, ensuring strict adherence to approved credit limits.
• Ensure no orders are released against expected fraudulent cheques or deposits.
• Prepare monthly reconciliations as part of incentive packs in the prescribed format.

• For interim payments with no allocation instructions, obtain written confirmation from the customer that the amount should remain unallocated.
• Ensure no unallocated amounts remain over month-end.3. Billing Management
• Submit monthly contractual billings to BUH by close of business on Business Day 13.
• Load approved contractual billings on Syspro and upload to the Company Shared Drive by Business Day 18.

• Submit all AR adjustments for approval by the AR Manager.
• Save full supporting documentation for all adjustments on the Company Shared Drive.
• Prepare and submit incentive packs based on cash collection performance by Business Day 4 in the prescribed format.5. Credit Committee Preparation

• Ensure all action items are addressed by the subsequent credit committee meeting.
• Provide required responses even if unable to attend the meeting.6. Customer Service

• External: Handle and resolve all customer queries in a professional, timely, and customer-focused manner.Key Skills & Competencies

• Excellent time management and organisational skills
• Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
• Sound understanding of credit risk and AR processes
• ERP system proficiency (Syspro experience advantageous)

As a Level 3 Support Engineer, you serve as the final escalation point within the technical support structure, responsible for resolving the most complex issues, leading preventative initiatives, and mentoring other engineers. Your core objective is to maintain high availability and reliability across client systems and services while minimizing escalations through a proactive, preventive approach.
Beyond issue resolution, this role requires high-level consulting, project execution, infrastructure management, and cross-department collaboration. You will also play a pivotal role in training and guiding Level 1 and 2 Support Engineers, contributing to service excellence and a learning-oriented support culture.
Why this role matters
In today's IT-driven businesses, operational stability, data integrity, and uptime are paramount. The Level 3 Support Engineer is essential in ensuring these needs are met. You don’t just react to incidents, you prevent them. By resolving deep-rooted technical challenges, mentoring teams, and ensuring compliance and security best practices, you help build confidence with clients and empower your team. Your ability to spot systemic weaknesses and correct them before they escalate directly impacts the quality, trust, and continuity of service.
Key Responsibilities
Advanced Technical Escalations & Incident Resolution
• Act as the final escalation point for complex technical issues from Level 1 and 2 Support Engineers.

• Windows Server environments (AD, DNS, DHCP, File Services, GPO)
• Azure services (VMs, virtual networks, storage, conditional access, identity)
• Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Compliance)
• Network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, VLANs)

• Implement, review, and enhance security measures based on threat intelligence and vendor guidance. Proactive Monitoring & Problem Prevention
• Proactively monitor infrastructure through RMM tools and log analysis to identify and correct issues before they impact clients.
• Review service alerts and implement the Remedy, Adjust, Remove approach to fine-tune the alerting system.

• Conduct audits of system configurations, documentation, and procedures to ensure alignment with best practices and compliance standards. Mentorship, Collaboration & Leadership
• Mentor and guide Level 1 and 2 Support Engineers, providing on-the-spot coaching, structured learning sessions, and knowledge reviews.

• Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with clients by demonstrating technical authority and consistency. Project & Change Implementation
• Participate in or lead infrastructure upgrade projects, cloud migrations, hybrid deployments, and IT rollouts.

• Conduct validation testing and change control documentation in alignment with change management procedures. Documentation, SOPs & Knowledge Management

• Ensure all ticket notes and time entries in PSA (e.g., Autotask) are timely, accurate, and useful for historical reference.
• Translate real-world incidents into future training topics or documentation improvements. Process Improvement & Innovation

• Collaborate with management and other teams to suggest technology upgrades, tool adoption, or workflow redesigns. Cross Departmental and Third-Party Collaboration
• Coordinate with Professional Services, NOC, and Security teams to ensure cohesive execution of shared responsibilities.

about_role:
We are looking for an energetic, sales-driven Floor Supervisor to join the Nintendo Store team at Sandton City.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about gaming, technology and creating memorable customer experiences. You will take ownership of daily activity on the sales floor, support the Store Manager and lead the team in achieving sales, service and operational targets.
The role is responsible for driving daily sales performance through active floor leadership, upselling and cross-selling, while ensuring that merchandising, customer experience and team execution remain aligned with Nintendo’s brand standards.
What You’ll Be Responsible For
Sales Performance
• Lead by example on the sales floor and drive the achievement of daily and monthly revenue targets.
• Actively promote cross-selling and upselling, with a strong focus on games, accessories and protection plans.
• Monitor sales performance throughout the day and adjust floor activities where required.
• Drive key sales measures, including average transaction value, units per transaction and product attachment rates.
• Support the team in converting customer traffic and product demonstrations into sales.
Floor Operations and Merchandising
• Maintain excellent floor presentation and visual merchandising standards.
• Ensure demonstration areas, interactive stations and trial products are clean, fully operational and properly stocked.
• Manage floor replenishment and ensure products are available on displays.
• Complete daily opening and closing floor checks, including point-of-sale readiness and security checks.
• Assist the Store Manager with stock counts, inventory control and shrink management.
Customer Experience
• Create an engaging, interactive and memorable experience for every customer.
• Ensure the team actively engages customers across all areas of the store.
• Respond to customer queries and resolve floor-related concerns quickly and professionally.
• Gather customer feedback and share relevant insights with the Store Manager.
• Maintain high customer satisfaction and mystery shopper standards.
Team Leadership
• Supervise, motivate and coach Retail Sales Associates and Brand Ambassadors during shifts.
• Conduct daily pre-shift meetings to communicate sales targets, promotional priorities and key products.
• Provide ongoing coaching on product knowledge, gaming titles, selling techniques and customer engagement.
• Ensure effective floor coverage and manage team rotations during busy trading periods.
• Monitor punctuality, dress code, conduct and performance.
• Address performance or behavioural concerns promptly and professionally.
• Consistently demonstrate and reinforce the company values of Focus, Passion, Innovation, Getting Things Done, Teamwork, Embracing Difference and Integrity.
What We’re Looking For
• A Higher Certificate or Diploma in Business, Retail Management, Marketing or a related field. A degree would be advantageous.
• 2 to 3 years’ experience in a high-volume retail environment.
• At least one year of experience in a supervisory, team leader or senior sales position.
• Previous experience in gaming, consumer technology, interactive retail or lifestyle brands would be highly advantageous.
• Strong sales closing, upselling and cross-selling ability.
• A genuine passion for gaming and technology.
• Strong communication, coaching and people-management skills.
• Basic knowledge of inventory management and point-of-sale controls.
• The ability to remain hands-on, energetic and customer-focused in a busy retail environment.
Why This Role?
This is an opportunity to work in an exciting, interactive retail environment where gaming, technology and customer experience come together. You will play an important role in creating the energy on the sales floor, developing the team and helping customers discover the world of Nintendo.

To ensure the reliable, safe, and efficient operation of all standby generator systems through preventative maintenance, corrective maintenance, inspections, testing, fault diagnosis, repairs, and emergency response, thereby maximizing equipment availability and minimizing downtime.

. Preventive Maintenance

• Check and top up engine oil, coolant, fuel, and other consumables where required.
• Replace filters, belts, hoses, and other consumable components during scheduled services.
• Perform load bank testing and functional testing as per maintenance schedules.
• Verify operation of battery chargers, engine heaters, and auxiliary systems.
. Corrective Maintenance
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and control system faults.
• Carry out repairs to restore equipment to full operational condition.
• Replace defective components using approved spare parts.
• Test repaired equipment before returning it to service.
• Perform emergency breakdown repairs during and outside normal working hours when required.
. Operational Testing
• Conduct routine generator start-up and shutdown tests.
• Verify automatic transfer switch (ATS) operation.
• Confirm generator synchronisation (where applicable).
• Test emergency stop circuits and safety shutdown functions.
• Verify generator operation under simulated power failure conditions.
. Monitoring and Inspections
• Monitor generator performance through the BMS, DSEWebNet and the generator controller
• Record operating hours, alarms, warning events, and fault history.
• Inspect for oil, coolant, diesel, and exhaust leaks.
• Monitor battery condition and charging systems.
• Verify fuel levels and report any abnormalities.
. Electrical and Control Systems
• Troubleshoot Deep Sea Electronics (DSE)
• Test and replace engine protection devices, sensors, and alarms.
• Verify communication with BMS and remote monitoring platforms.
• Assist with controller programming and parameter verification where authorized and needed.
. Fuel System Maintenance
• Inspect diesel tanks, pipework, pumps, filters, and water separators.
• Inspect and Manage Diesel Bowsers
• Check for fuel contamination and water ingress.
• Coordinate fuel sampling, fuel polishing, and tank cleaning where required.
. Documentation and Reporting
• Complete maintenance reports, service sheets, and inspection checklists.
• Record equipment readings and service history.
• Report defects and recommend corrective actions.
• Provide quotations for repairs and replacement parts when required.
• Maintain accurate asset records.
. Health, Safety and Compliance
• Comply with all HSE requirements, manage work permit, and lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) procedures.
• Maintain good housekeeping in generator rooms.
• Ensure compliance with OEM specifications, SANS standards, and site safety requirements.
. Contractor and Client Support
• Supervise specialist contractors during major repairs and overhauls.
• Attend technical meetings when required.
• Assist with equipment commissioning and handover.
• Support client audits and statutory inspections.
1. Emergency Response
• After Hours Support
• Respond to generator failures.
• Restore critical standby power systems during outages.
• Provide after-hours standby support and call-out services.
Deliverables

Purpose
To assist the Standby Generator Technician in maintaining, inspecting, testing, and repairing standby generator systems, ensuring reliable operation of critical power infrastructure while complying with health, safety, and quality standards.
Key Responsibilities
. Preventive Maintenance Support
• Assist with scheduled preventive maintenance on standby generators and associated equipment.
• Clean generators, radiators, alternators, control panels, and generator rooms.
• Check and replenish engine oil, coolant, and other consumables under supervision.
• Assist with replacing filters, belts, hoses, batteries, and other serviceable components.
• Prepare tools, equipment, and spare parts for maintenance activities.
. Routine Inspections
• Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly visual inspections of generators and associated systems.
• Check for oil, coolant, fuel, and exhaust leaks.
• Inspect battery terminals, battery electrolyte levels (where applicable), and battery chargers.
• Record generator operating hours, fuel levels, and equipment condition.
• Report abnormalities to the Standby Generator Technician.
. Operational Assistance
• Assist with generator start-up and shutdown procedures.
• Support routine generator exercising and load testing.
• Observe generator performance during testing and report unusual noise, vibration, smoke, or alarms.
• Assist in verifying Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) operation.
. Corrective Maintenance Support
• Assist with fault-finding and repair activities.
• Remove and install mechanical and electrical components under supervision.
• Assist with cable termination, wiring, and component replacement where authorised.
• Help restore equipment to service following repairs.
. Fuel System Support
• Assist with diesel tank inspections and fuel level monitoring.
• Check for water contamination and fuel leaks.
• Assist with fuel deliveries and fuel transfer operations.
• Maintain cleanliness of fuel storage areas.
. Housekeeping
• Maintain clean and safe generator rooms.
• Ensure tools and equipment are cleaned and stored correctly.
• Dispose of waste materials in accordance with environmental procedures.
• Keep maintenance areas free of hazards.
. Documentation
• Assist in completing maintenance checklists and inspection reports.
• Record equipment readings and operating hours.
• Report defects identified during inspections.
• Assist with updating maintenance records and asset information.
. Health, Safety and Compliance
• Follow all HSE requirements, lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) procedures, and permit-to-work systems.
• Wear the required personal protective equipment (PPE).
• Maintain safe working practices at all times.
• Report unsafe conditions, incidents, and near misses immediately.
. Emergency Response
• Support emergency generator call-outs and breakdown repairs.
• Assist with restoring standby power during utility failures.
• Participate in the standby roster as required

Introduction:
As the Manager: Cyber Security Operations, you are responsible for managing the day-to-day execution of cyber security operations to ensure effective monitoring, detection, response and recovery across the organisation’s technology environment.
Description:
THE JOB AT A GLANCE
As the Manager: Cyber Security Operations, you are responsible for managing the day-to-day execution of cyber security operations to ensure effective monitoring, detection, response and recovery across the organisation’s technology environment. Your role supports the Head of Cyber Security Operations in maintaining a resilient and intelligence-driven cyber defence capability that is aligned to operational priorities, risk requirements and service expectations.
Your role provides operational leadership over SOC activities, cyber incident response coordination, vulnerability remediation tracking, threat detection improvement and cyber resilience readiness. It ensures that cyber operational controls, processes and technologies are functioning effectively and that threats and incidents are addressed in a timely, controlled and well-documented manner.
Your role also serves as a key operational interface between cyber security operations and other technology and business stakeholders, enabling effective coordination during incidents, remediation programmes, audits and operational initiatives. You are accountable for team supervision, operational reporting, process improvement and continuous enhancement of cyber security operational performance.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Security Operations Centre (SOC) & SIEM Management
• Manage the day-to-day operation of the Security Operations Centre (SOC), ensuring continuous monitoring, alert triage, investigation, and timely escalation
• Oversee the effective use of the SIEM platform, including monitoring coverage, use case execution, alert quality, and operational tuning
• Support the optimization of detection rules, use cases, and alert correlation to improve visibility and reduce false positives
• Ensure SOC procedures, playbooks, escalation paths, and service levels are consistently applied and maintained.
Cyber Incident Management & Response
• Manage operational cyber incident response processes, including detection, logging, triage, escalation, containment, eradication, recovery, and closure.
• Coordinate cross-functional response activities during cyber incidents, working with IT, Legal, Risk, and business stakeholders as required.
• Support the Head of Cybersecurity Operations during major incidents and provide operational leadership during lower to medium severity incidents.
• Facilitate post-incident reviews, root cause documentation, and tracking of lessons learned and corrective actions.
Threat Hunting & Adversary Detection
• Coordinate proactive threat hunting activities aimed at identifying hidden threats, suspicious behaviour, and advanced attack indicators
• Support the use of threat intelligence, behavioural analytics, and internal testing results to improve monitoring and detection effectiveness
• Assist with internal penetration testing, purple team exercises, and validation of detection controls
• Help refine detection use cases in response to changes in threat landscape, attack trends, and business risk.
Vulnerability & Patch Management
• Manage vulnerability scanning schedules, remediation tracking, and reporting across infrastructure, applications, cloud platforms, and endpoints
• Work with IT teams to prioritise and remediate vulnerabilities based on risk, exploitability, and business impact
• Coordinate patch management follow-up to ensure critical updates are implemented within agreed timelines
• Report on vulnerability posture, patch compliance, remediation performance, and areas of material exposure.
Cyber Resilience & Crisis Readiness
• Support the planning and execution of cyber resilience activities, including breach simulations, ransomware scenarios, and operational readiness exercises
• Coordinate operational preparedness for high-impact security incidents and support enterprise crisis response structures when invoked
• Assist in testing and validating operational response capabilities, recovery actions, and communication procedures.
Breach Containment, Recovery & Forensics
• Coordinate containment, recovery and restoration activities during cyber incidents to minimise operational disruption
• Support forensic evidence handling, investigation coordination and incident documentation in line with policy and legal requirements
• Ensure recovery actions are properly tracked, validated and closed out following incidents.
Threat Intelligence Integration
• Support the integration of relevant internal and external threat intelligence into cyber operations processes and monitoring activities
• Ensure threat intelligence is converted into practical detection improvements, watchlists, and response actions
• Maintain operational awareness of current cyber threats relevant to the organisation’s industry and environment.
Operational Reporting & Management Reporting
• Produce regular operational and management reports covering cyber incidents, SOC performance, threat activity, vulnerability exposure, remediation progress, and resilience readiness
• Track and report key performance and risk indicators such as MTTD, MTTR, dwell time, incident volumes, and remediation status
• Escalate material trends, risks, and operational issues to the Head of Cybersecurity Operations with clear analysis and recommendations
• Maintain reporting dashboards and management information to support continuous improvement and informed decision-making.
Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Coordination
• Work closely with IT Operations, Infrastructure, Software Development, Cybersecurity Engineering, IT GRC, Risk, and Legal teams to ensure effective operational coordination
• Act as a key operational liaison during incidents, vulnerability remediation, and cyber resilience activities
• Support alignment between cybersecurity operations processes and broader technology and business requirements.
Technology & Capability Enablement
• Support the implementation, configuration, and optimisation of security operations tooling, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence platforms
• Ensure operational processes take advantage of automation and integration opportunities to improve efficiency and response speed
• Contribute to the delivery of cybersecurity roadmap initiatives relevant to operations
• Support secure onboarding and operational readiness of new platforms, cloud services, and third-party solutions.
Leadership & Capability Development
• Supervise and develop cybersecurity operations staff, including analysts and other operational resources assigned to the function
• Manage work allocation, shift coverage or operational schedules, quality of output, and adherence to procedures and SLAs
• Provide coaching, mentoring, and on-the-job development to strengthen operational capability and readiness
• Promote a culture of accountability, responsiveness, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
WHAT YOU WILL GET IN RETURN
We offer great opportunities for personal and professional development in a stable company that is 132 years strong. The role comes with a competitive salary package and various benefits. Furthermore, you will be part of a dedicated group of colleagues who value teamwork and collaboration.
